grammar.title: 强调句型
grammar.explanation: 强调句用于突出句中某一部分，结构为It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余部分。
grammar.structure: It is/was + 强调部分 + that/who + 其余

examples.sentence: It was in 2008 that the Olympics were held in Beijing.
examples.translation: 正是在2008年奥运会在北京举办。

examples.sentence: It is the government that should take responsibility.
examples.translation: 正是政府应当承担责任。

grammar.ieltsTip: 雅思口语Part 3和写作中使用强调句，可让观点表达更有力。

speaking.topic: Describe an important decision you made
speaking.cueCard: Describe an important decision you had to make. You should say: what the decision was / when you made it / what the result was / and explain why it was important.
speaking.sampleAnswer: One of the most significant decisions I've ever made was choosing to study abroad for my postgraduate degree rather than entering the workforce immediately after graduation. I made this decision during the final year of my undergraduate studies, after countless discussions with my family and mentors. The result was a transformative two years in the UK, where I gained not only specialized knowledge in my field but also a broader worldview and lifelong friendships. This decision was crucial because it fundamentally altered the trajectory of my career—exposure to different educational methodologies and international perspectives made me more competitive in the job market. Moreover, living independently in a foreign country fostered my personal growth, teaching me resilience and adaptability. Looking back, I'm certain that this decision, though daunting at the time, was one of the best I've ever made.
speaking.tips: 讲述决定时强调过程和结果，体现反思能力。
